source: Written by the Interim team (CLAUDE.md §00 'speak to non-clinicians first'; CONTRACTS.md R3.1). SDTM variable meanings follow the CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide AE/VS/CM domains; grade words follow the NCI CTCAE v5.0 general grade descriptions (Grade 1 Mild, 2 Moderate, 3 Severe); the 24-hour reporting clocks follow protocol R2810-ONC-1624 Amendment 9 §9.4.2 (p. 91) and §9.4.3 (p. 92), cached in data/public/empower_lung1_protocol_excerpt.json.
rationale: The dashboard leads with plain words and keeps SDTM names and rule ids one click deeper. Every rule id the engine or the chart-note scanner can emit (rules_catalog.json, plus the protocol / AESI ids of CONTRACTS.md R3.1) has a short sentence template and a fallback that needs no inputs, so a missing input never breaks a sentence. Templates use {input_name} placeholders that are filled only from the rule's own inputs. No sentence gives medical advice; every grade carries 'provisional, investigator to confirm' and every special-interest event 'possible AESI, investigator to confirm'.

AEREL.label: Related to the study drug? (investigator decides)

AEACN.label: Change made to the study drug because of it

INTERIM_PROVISIONAL.label: Draft waiting for a person to confirm

INTERIM_FOLLOWUP_OF.label: Follow-up to an earlier side-effect record

INTERIM_AESI_SUSPECTED.label: Possible event of special interest (possible AESI, investigator to confirm)

INTERIM_RECORD_SOURCE.label: Where this record came from (check-in, chart note or phone call)

render_as_rationale: Inputs that hold SDTM variable names are shown with their plain field label; inputs that hold check-in item ids are shown with the item's plain label from proctcae_items.json.
input_aliases_rationale: A placeholder is filled from the first of its names present in the rule inputs; the protocol rules (CONTRACTS.md R3.1) were written concurrently, so alternate input names are accepted.

tiers.3: Urgent: study team contacts the participant today

grades_source: NCI CTCAE v5.0 general grade descriptions (Grade 1 Mild, Grade 2 Moderate, Grade 3 Severe). Interim never assigns grade 4 or 5 (composite_to_grade.json).

sae.name: Serious event report due
sae.note: All serious adverse events are reported to the sponsor within 24 hours, whatever their cause (protocol §9.4.2).

aesi.name: Special-interest event report due
aesi.note: Possible AESI, investigator to confirm. Events of special interest are reported within 24 hours the same way as serious events (protocol §9.4.3).

evidence_kinds.gate_answer: Participant's answer to a closing question
